blocks.text: The Zscaler and Smartsheet Deployment Guide provides instructions on how to configure Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) and Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) to work with the Smartsheet platform.
The SaaS Security Data at Rest Scanning Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policy allows you to create rules to discover and protect sensitive data at rest in sanctioned SaaS applications such as Smartsheet.

This policy uses Zscaler DLP engines to scan content for Smartsheet. You can configure criteria, such as file type or collaboration scope, to specify the type of content for the policy to scan. You can also configure actions for the policy to take if it detects content that matches the criteria.
